lead.titleZh: CrossFit 女性盆底功能障碍及肌少症老年女性电刺激的证据更新
lead.titleEn: Evidence Update: Pelvic Floor Dysfunction in CrossFit Women and Electrical Stimulation in Sarcopenic Older Women
lead.paragraphZh: 今日我们关注 3 篇研究，覆盖 3 个专业方向。其中有 2 篇 curatedScore 75 分的最高分研究，包括一篇系统综述和一篇 RCT，分别讨论 CrossFit 训练女性的盆底功能障碍和肌少症老年女性全身电肌肉刺激的效果。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's edition features 3 studies across 3 specialties. The highest curatedScore of 75 goes to two articles: a systematic review on pelvic floor dysfunction in women practicing CrossFit, and an RCT examining whole-body electromyostimulation in older women with sarcopenia.

items.title: Prevalence and Associated Factors of Pelvic Floor Dysfunction in Women Who Practice CrossFit®: A Systematic Review
items.summary: This systematic review of 16 cross-sectional and two case-control studies investigated pelvic floor dysfunction prevalence in female CrossFit practitioners. It found urinary incontinence rates from 14.5% to 84%, with longer CrossFit practice, higher intensity, and jump rope exercises associated with increased risk.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述强调了 CrossFit 训练女性盆底功能障碍的高患病率，特别是尿失禁。它指出了训练时间、强度和高冲击练习（如跳绳）与症状之间的关联，提示临床医生应在为从事这类运动的女性提供咨询时考虑这些风险因素。
items.titleZh: CrossFit® 训练女性盆底功能障碍的患病率及相关因素：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述纳入了 16 项横断面研究和 2 项病例对照研究，调查了 CrossFit 训练女性盆底功能障碍的患病率。结果显示，尿失禁的患病率从 14.5% 到 84% 不等，且 CrossFit 训练时间越长、强度越高以及跳绳练习与风险增加相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights the high prevalence of pelvic floor dysfunction, particularly urinary incontinence, among women who practice CrossFit. It points to associations between longer practice duration, higher intensity, and high-impact exercises like jump rope, suggesting clinicians should consider these risk factors when counseling women engaged in such sports.
items.limitation: 纳入的研究多为横断面设计，难以确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The included studies were predominantly cross-sectional, making it difficult to establish causality.

items.title: Strength Training in Youth: A Scoping Review with Evidence Gap Map
items.summary: This scoping review of 342 studies on youth strength training (6–18 years) found 90% assessed physical performance, with limited focus on motor competence, injury prevention, or psychosocial factors. Key gaps include under-representation of female participants, scarce studies on biologically mature adolescents, and lack of long-term follow-up beyond 6 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述发现，青少年力量训练的研究主要集中在身体表现上，但在女性参与者、生物成熟度评估、长期随访和心理社会结局方面存在显著差距。这提醒临床医师在为青少年制定训练方案时，需关注这些研究盲区。
items.titleZh: 青少年力量训练：一项带证据差距地图的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项对 342 项青少年力量训练（6-18 岁）研究的范围综述发现，90% 的研究评估了身体表现，而对运动能力、损伤预防或社会心理因素的关注有限。主要空白包括女性参与者不足、对生物成熟青少年研究稀缺以及缺乏超过 6 个月的长期随访。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review found that youth strength training research predominantly focuses on physical performance, with significant gaps in female representation, biological maturation assessment, long-term follow-up, and psychosocial outcomes. This highlights critical blind spots for clinicians when designing training programs for young athletes.
items.limitation: 本综述识别的是证据空白，而非提供训练实践的确定性建议。
items.limitationEn: This review identifies evidence gaps rather than providing definitive recommendations for training practice.

items.title: Does whole-body electromyostimulation improve functional, compositional, and biochemical outcomes in older women with sarcopenia? A randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This open-label RCT of 30 sarcopenic older women found 8 weeks of whole-body electromyostimulation (WB-EMS) significantly improved balance, handgrip strength, functional capacity, body composition (reduced body weight/BMI/fat, increased skeletal muscle mass), and myokine levels (decreased myostatin, increased follistatin) compared to controls. The trial was retrospectively registered.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，全身电肌肉刺激（WB-EMS）在肌少症老年女性中能改善身体功能、身体成分和肌因子水平。对于无法进行常规阻力训练的患者，WB-EMS 可能是一个时间高效的替代方案，但需等待更大规模、更高质量的研究验证。
items.titleZh: 全身电肌肉刺激能否改善肌少症老年女性的功能、身体成分和生化结局？一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项对 30 名肌少症老年女性进行的开放标签随机对照试验发现，与对照组相比，8 周的全身电肌肉刺激 (WB-EMS) 显著改善了平衡、握力、功能能力、身体成分（体重/BMI/脂肪减少，骨骼肌质量增加）和肌因子水平（肌抑素减少，卵泡抑素增加）。本试验为回顾性注册。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that whole-body electromyostimulation (WB-EMS) can improve physical function, body composition, and myokine levels in sarcopenic older women. For patients unable to perform conventional resistance training, WB-EMS might be a time-efficient alternative, but validation from larger, higher-quality studies is needed.
items.limitation: 本研究为开放标签试验，未进行分配隐藏和结局评估盲法，可能存在偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was an open-label trial without allocation concealment and blinded outcome assessment, which may introduce bias.
